etymology.historical_story: English ouch is recorded as a pain exclamation and is commonly traced to German autsch. Its use has also extended to humorous responses to hurtful remarks. When inserted into a Malay sentence, it retains this expressive role as an English element; that occurrence does not by itself establish it as a standard Malay headword. [Etymology reference](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/ouch)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /aʊ/ 联想到疼痛时张口喊出的“嗷”，最后收成 /tʃ/：ouch，就是“哎哟”。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语感叹词，可在马来语非正式混语交流中整词使用；末尾 s 不是复数或马来语词缀。英语通常读一个音节；数据包缺失的 syllables 和 Jawi 保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 哎呀；糟了。发现自己犯了小错、失手或出现小意外时发出的轻微惊讶或歉意。
senses.en_definition: An exclamation acknowledging a minor mistake or accident, often with mild surprise or apology.
senses.ms_definition: Seruan tidak formal apabila menyedari kesilapan kecil atau kejadian yang tidak disengajakan, kadangkala untuk menyatakan rasa kesal.
senses.nuances: 实际词类为 interjection／kata seru；因指定枚举无该项，暂映射为 particle。马来语释义为编辑释义，并非 DBP 官方引文。status 按指定格式保留 official，不代表已核实为官方马来语词条。下列为会话组合，不是固定短语。英语用法参照 [Oxford：oops](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/oops)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam laporan itu, ungkapan tidak formal “oops” digantikan dengan “maaf, terdapat kesilapan”.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在该报告中，非正式表达“oops”被改为“抱歉，出现了错误”。
dual_scenarios.en: In the report, the informal expression “oops” was replaced with “we apologise; an error occurred”.

dual_scenarios.en: Oops, I sent that message to the wrong group!

aku、dah、tu 分别对应 saya、sudah／telah、itu。
kat 在此口语表达中对应标准语的 kepada。
标准语对译用 maaf 表达歉意，不把 oops 当作正式用语。

messages.ms_spoken: oops, aku dah hantar mesej tu kat kumpulan yang salah!

messages.ms_standard: Padamkan mesej itu dahulu, kemudian beritahu mereka bahawa awak tersalah menghantarnya.
messages.zh: 先删掉吧，再跟他们说你发错了。
messages.en: Just delete it first, then tell them you sent it by mistake.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适合熟人间的小失误。面对客户、长辈或受到实际影响的人，单说 oops 容易显得轻率；宜用 maaf 并说明如何补救。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合发错普通消息、打错字等轻微情境。严重损失、伤害或正式道歉场合应清楚承认错误；正式马来语文书通常改用 maaf、tersilap 或 terdapat kesilapan。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合发错普通消息、打错字等轻微情境。严重损失、伤害或正式道歉场合应清楚承认错误；正式马来语文书通常改用 maaf、tersilap 或 terdapat kesilapan。

etymology.historical_story: Oops comes from English exclamatory usage rather than Malay affixation. Its appeal is conversational: a short sound makes a small mishap immediately recognisable to listeners. Research on English oops and whoops examines their relationship with expressions of apology. In a Malay conversation, retaining oops introduces an English conversational item rather than creating a new Malay derivative. See [Lutzky and Kehoe's study](https://www.open-access.bcu.ac.uk/4794/1/Lutzky%26Kehoe%20Oops%20SI%20FINAL.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手一滑、消息发错群，马上脱口而出 oops——就是“哎呀，弄错了”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + only → only（英语整词，用于语码转换）
morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语语境中按英语整词处理，不把 -ly 分析为马来语后缀。IPA 采用标准英式读音；马来西亚英语的实际读音可能不同。此处 is_root 表示没有马来语派生结构。

senses.zh_definition: 只；仅；不过；用于限制数量、对象、行为或范围。
senses.en_definition: Exclusively or merely; with no additional person, thing, amount, or action.
senses.ms_definition: Hanya atau sahaja, untuk mengehadkan jumlah, perkara, orang atau tindakan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词，出现在马来语句子中属于语码转换，并非标准马来语对应词。正式马来语通常用 hanya、cuma 或 sahaja；only 的位置决定限制范围。下列搭配保留真实英语结构。[DBP：only 的马来语对译](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=sahaja)

senses.zh_definition: 唯一的；仅有的；指子女时表示独生的。
senses.en_definition: Sole or unique; having no others of the same kind.
senses.ms_definition: Satu-satunya atau tunggal; bagi anak, tidak mempunyai adik-beradik.
senses.nuances: 这是英语形容词用法；马来语分别用 satu-satunya 或 tunggal。the only option 对应 satu-satunya pilihan，only child 对应 anak tunggal。[DBP：only](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=sahaja)

senses.zh_definition: 只是；不过；用于补充限制、障碍或转折。
senses.en_definition: Except that; but, introducing a qualification or obstacle.
senses.ms_definition: Tetapi atau cuma, untuk memperkenalkan batasan atau halangan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语连接词用法，不应直接当作标准马来语连词。马来语表达应按语境使用 tetapi、cuma 或 tetapi dengan syarat。[American Heritage：only](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=only)

collocations.en: except that there is a problem

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式马来语公文应使用马来语对应表达，引用英文标识时可保留原文。本记录的 official 是所要求的数据状态标签，不表示 only 获认定为标准马来语词。

etymology.historical_story: English only descends through Middle English from Old English ānlīc, formed from elements meaning one and having the form of. That history helps explain its connection with uniqueness. In Malay conversation, it remains identifiable as English when speakers insert it into a Malay sentence; its English ending is not a Malay affix. [American Heritage: only](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=only)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 only 和 one 联想：聚光灯只照中一个对象或一个范围，就是“只、仅、唯一”。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中按完整借词记忆；末尾 -ik 不作为本条的马来语生产性后缀拆分。IPA 采用马来西亚马来语的宽式拼读，不沿用输入包中可能带区域读音的候选值。

senses.zh_definition: 源自动物、植物等生物，或与其物质和过程有关的。
senses.en_definition: Of, relating to, or derived from living organisms.
senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan atau berasal daripada sumber haiwan atau tumbuhan.
senses.nuances: 常用于土壤、堆肥及生物来源的物质。bahan organik 说明物质性质，并不自动表示有机认证。参见 [DBP：organik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=organik)。

senses.zh_definition: 化学上属于有机化合物的，或与这类碳化合物的研究有关的。
senses.en_definition: Relating to organic carbon compounds or the chemistry that studies them.
senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan sebatian karbon yang tergolong dalam sebatian organik atau kajian tentangnya.
senses.nuances: 属于化学术语，不表示“天然”或“无害”；也不能把一切含碳物质都直接归为有机物。参见 [DBP：organik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=organik)。

senses.zh_definition: 农业及农产品语境中，采用有机生产方式种植或生产的。
senses.en_definition: Grown or produced using organic agricultural methods.
senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan kaedah pertanian yang menggunakan sumber semula jadi serta mengehadkan input sintetik.
senses.nuances: 用于农业方法或产品属性；与化学义的“有机”须按语境区分。参见 [DBP：organik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=organik)。

senses.zh_definition: 医学上与身体组织或器官的结构性病变有关的；器质性的。
senses.en_definition: Involving structural changes or pathology in bodily tissues or organs.
senses.ms_definition: Melibatkan perubahan struktur atau keadaan patologi pada tisu atau organ tubuh.
senses.nuances: 属于医学专业用法，不能按食品语境译成“天然的”。参见 [DBP：organik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=organik)。

senses.zh_definition: 各组成部分相互联系、协调构成整体的；有机联系的。
senses.en_definition: Having interconnected parts that form a coordinated whole.
senses.ms_definition: Mempunyai bahagian yang saling berhubung dan membentuk keseluruhan yang tersusun.
senses.nuances: 多见于社会、组织及理论讨论，属于整体结构的比喻义。参见 [DBP：organic 英马释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=organik)。

collocations.zh: 各部分相互联系的社会整体

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合农业、化学、医学及社会理论语境。日常购物中的 organik 不应直接理解为“绝对安全”“完全没有化学物质”或“必然更健康”。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 讨论食品选择时保持中性，避免把购买有机食品当作评价他人生活方式或经济条件的标准。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合农业、化学、医学及社会理论语境。日常购物中的 organik 不应直接理解为“绝对安全”“完全没有化学物质”或“必然更健康”。

etymology.historical_story: Organik belongs to an international scientific vocabulary ultimately associated with Greek organikos and organon, meaning an instrument or organ. Across that vocabulary, meanings developed around bodily organization, living things, and carbon chemistry. The agricultural meaning came later. This history explains why one familiar label can describe food, chemical compounds, or bodily disease. See [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/organic) and [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/organic).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 organik，先看后面的名词：baja 是有机肥，kimia 是有机化学，penyakit 是器质性疾病；用搭配锁定义项。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为现代派生构词的基词整体处理；它是已固定连写的复合词，不含词缀。词尾 a 在部分马来西亚标准读音中实现为 [ə]，也可读 [a]。

senses.zh_definition: 田径运动；包括跑、跳、投掷以及竞走等项目。
senses.en_definition: Athletics: sporting events involving running, jumping, throwing, and race walking.
senses.ms_definition: Sukan yang merangkumi acara larian, lompatan, balingan dan jalan kaki.
senses.nuances: 在马来西亚的学校比赛、体育新闻及赛事名称中，通常指田径；不要把 kejohanan olahraga 理解成涵盖所有球类的综合运动会。此义对应 [DBP 的 atletik 同义词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=olahraga)。

senses.zh_definition: 广义的体育锻炼或运动，尤其指需要体力、敏捷性或耐力的身体活动。
senses.en_definition: Physical exercise or sport requiring strength, agility, or stamina.
senses.ms_definition: Latihan atau sukan yang memerlukan kekuatan fizikal, ketangkasan atau stamina.
senses.nuances: 这是词典记录的较宽泛义，具体范围须看上下文；日常泛指运动时，sukan 或 senaman 往往更明确。释义依据 [Kamus Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=olahraga)。

etymology.historical_story: Olahraga preserves a body-centred image: raga is recorded in Malay as a Javanese-derived word for the body. The established compound is written as one word, a spelling explicitly confirmed by DBP. Its dictionary meaning covers physical exercise broadly, while Malaysian competition contexts commonly use it for athletics. See [DBP on raga and the compound spelling](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=raga).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 raga＝身体：让身体动起来，再联想操场上的跑、跳、投；整词写成 olahraga。

etymology.historical_story: Osaka comes from the Japanese place name Ōsaka, commonly interpreted as 'large slope.' Historical records used both 大坂 and 大阪; the latter became established during the Meiji period. Osaka's municipal account notes that the precise origin remains uncertain. In Malay, the name is borrowed whole rather than formed from Malay roots. [Osaka municipal account](https://www.osaka-city-callcenter.jp/faq/detail.aspx?id=397)

etymology.historical_story: Latin optimus means “best” and functions as the superlative of bonus, “good.” That Latin meaning should be distinguished from a modern name. Hasbro identifies Optimus Prime as an Autobot leader, but the isolated packet does not establish that this character is its intended referent or that optimus is an established Malay common word. [Lewis and Short](https://alatius.com/ls/index.php?l=optuma), [Hasbro](https://instructions.hasbro.com/en-us/instruction/transformers-cybertron-leader-class-optimus-prime-figure).

senses.zh_definition: 橡树；通常树体高大、木材坚硬结实，可供建筑及家具制造使用的一类树木。
senses.en_definition: An oak tree, valued for its hard, strong timber used in construction and furniture.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis pokok yang besar, kayunya yang keras dan kuat biasanya digunakan sebagai bahan binaan, perabot dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 植物名称；通常用 pokok oak 明确指树木。不要把所有结实的硬木树种都称为 oak。

senses.zh_definition: 橡木；橡树所产的坚硬木材，常用于家具、地板及建筑构件。
senses.en_definition: The hard, strong wood of an oak tree, used especially for furniture, flooring and construction.
senses.ms_definition: Kayu daripada pokok oak yang keras dan kuat, digunakan untuk membuat perabot, lantai dan bahan binaan.
senses.nuances: 由树名转指木材的常见用法；此处释义是对资料包所述木材用途的展开。商品名称中的 kemasan oak 可能仅指橡木外观的饰面，不必然表示实心橡木。

etymology.historical_story: Malay oak is a whole-word borrowing of English oak. Its spelling preserves the English vowel letters, while the supplied Malay pronunciation is the single syllable /ok/. The dictionary description connects the tree directly with its hard, strong timber. This makes furniture and building materials useful contexts for remembering the word without inventing a Malay root or affix.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: oak 按 /ok/ 一拍读：想到一张结实的橡木桌，把“树名—木材—家具”连起来记。

etymology.historical_story: Orléans preserves a sequence of older Latin place names, including Aurelianum and Aurelianis. Archaeological accounts identify the late Roman city as Civitas Aurelianorum. Its association with Emperor Aurelian is a historical interpretation rather than an entirely settled explanation. For Malay readers, the name functions as an imported geographical label, not a native descriptive word. [Historical account](https://multimedia.inrap.fr/atlas/orleans/syntheses/periodes-chronologiques/antiquite)

morphology.pattern_note: 英语借词在现代马来语中作为完整词根使用，不拆成 or- 与 -bit。meN- 在元音 o 前取 meng-：mengorbit。

senses.zh_definition: 天体、卫星或航天器在引力作用下围绕另一天体运行所循的轨道。
senses.en_definition: The path followed by a celestial body, satellite, or spacecraft around another body under gravity.
senses.ms_definition: Laluan planet, satelit atau jasad lain ketika mengelilingi sesuatu jasad cakerawala di bawah pengaruh graviti.
senses.nuances: 表示运行路径；表示“沿轨道运行”的动词通常用 mengorbit。轨道不一定是正圆。参见 [DBP：orbit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=orbit)。

senses.zh_definition: 在玻尔模型等简化原子模型中，电子绕原子核运动的轨道。
senses.en_definition: An electron's path around an atomic nucleus in a simplified model such as the Bohr model.
senses.ms_definition: Laluan elektron mengelilingi nukleus atom.
senses.nuances: 词典中的物理学义。教学时须说明模型范围；现代量子论的 orbital 表示与电子出现概率有关的空间分布，不等于确定的运行路径。参见 [DBP：orbit 与 orbital atom](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=orbit)。

senses.zh_definition: 【解剖学】容纳眼球的骨性腔，即眼眶。
senses.en_definition: The bony cavity that houses the eyeball; the eye socket.
senses.ms_definition: Rongga tulang pada tengkorak yang menempatkan bola mata.
senses.nuances: 专门术语，日常可用 rongga mata 帮助理解；必须结合眼部解剖语境辨义。参见 [DBP：orbit，生物学术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=rumah-rumah+1)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay borrowed orbit from English. Its deeper ancestry lies in Latin orbita, meaning a wheel track, course, or circuit. A track left on the ground thus provides a memorable image for an invisible path through space. Modern Malay keeps the borrowed noun intact and builds verbs with Malay affixes. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=orbit) and the [Paris Observatory dictionary](https://dictionary.obspm.fr/terms/orbit/).

etymology.historical_story: In 1803, Smithson Tennant investigated residue left after platinum was dissolved and identified osmium alongside iridium. Osmium takes its name from Greek osme, meaning smell, because of the strong odour associated with its oxide. The symbol Os abbreviates that element name, linking the Malay dictionary entry to international chemical notation. [Royal Society of Chemistry](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/76/osmium)

etymology.historical_story: Omega comes from a Greek name meaning big O, distinguishing it from omicron, little O. Its position at the end of the Greek alphabet also gave it symbolic associations with endings. Malay uses the borrowed name for the letter, while scientific terminology carries it into formulas and expressions such as omega-3. [Source: University College London](https://omega.cs.ucl.ac.uk/omega/)

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于历史、考古和旅游语境。若实际指机构、品牌或其他城市，应沿用其正式名称，避免直接解释为希腊遗址。

etymology.historical_story: Olympia is a place name associated with an ancient Greek sanctuary, rather than a Malay word formed with local affixes. Its temples and sporting grounds connected religious worship with athletic competition. The name carries that historical association into modern heritage writing, but the packet does not establish which Olympia its original source intended. [UNESCO](https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/517/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Olympia，联想 Olympic 的古代赛场；这是地名联想，不是马来语构词拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此为附着于名词后的代词性成分，表示所属或回指，严格说不是派生后缀；词根无音变，ny 读 /ɲ/。完整读音分节为 o.pe.ra.si.nya。输入的 Jawi 仅对应 operasi，完整形式为 اوڤراسيڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 其业务运作、经营活动；指前文提到的机构或企业所开展的业务。
senses.en_definition: Its business operations or activities, referring to a previously identified organization.
senses.ms_definition: Kegiatan perniagaan atau perusahaan pihak yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: -nya 的具体所指须由上下文确定；企业的多项经营活动在英语中常译为复数 operations。各义项依据 operasi 的词典义编写，加入 -nya 的回指意义，并非独立词条的逐字引文。[DBP：operasi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=operasi)

senses.zh_definition: 其运行、运转；指某个装置、机器或系统的工作过程。
senses.en_definition: The functioning or operation of a particular device, machine, or system.
senses.ms_definition: Perjalanan atau cara berfungsi alat, mesin atau sistem yang dimaksudkan.
senses.nuances: 中心意义是设备如何工作，不一定涉及商业经营。翻译时可用“该设备的运行”，避免机械地译成“他的操作”。

collocations.en: the smooth running of the system

senses.zh_definition: 其行动、专项任务；指某个单位所执行的军事、警务或其他有组织的行动。
senses.en_definition: Its organized operation, especially a military, police, or enforcement operation.
senses.ms_definition: Gerakan atau tindakan terancang yang dilaksanakan oleh pasukan atau pihak berkenaan.
senses.nuances: 须从上下文识别执行单位及行动目标；这里的 operasi 不指设备运行或外科手术。

senses.zh_definition: 他或她所接受的手术；也可依上下文指相关医生实施的手术。
senses.en_definition: His or her surgical operation, with the person's role determined by context.
senses.ms_definition: Pembedahan yang melibatkan orang berkenaan, sama ada sebagai pesakit atau sebagai pelaksana mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚正式医疗表达通常优先使用 pembedahan；pembedahannya 往往比 operasinya 更明确。

collocations.en: his or her operation was successful

senses.zh_definition: 其运算、运算步骤；指数学或计算过程中指定的运算。
senses.en_definition: The mathematical operation or calculation procedure under discussion.
senses.ms_definition: Proses hitungan tertentu yang dilakukan menurut aturan yang ditetapkan.
senses.nuances: 限数学、计算等语境；-nya 可回指前文指定的运算。以下为常用数学搭配的回指形式。

senses.zh_definition: 其集体公益行动；指某个团体组织的清洁、整修等协作活动。
senses.en_definition: Its organized communal work activity, such as a collective cleanup.
senses.ms_definition: Kerja kebajikan secara gotong-royong yang dijalankan oleh pihak berkenaan.
senses.nuances: 这是 operasi 的较具体用法，须有清洁、公益或社区协作等上下文；不能仅凭 operasinya 判断为公益活动。

collocations.en: its operation to clean up the area
its operation to clean the mosque

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies operasi as an English-origin loan and records meanings spanning surgery, machinery, business, and organized action. Operasinya combines that borrowed base with Malay -nya. The form illustrates a familiar language-contact process: an imported technical noun participates in local grammar, while context determines whose operation, or which previously mentioned operation, is intended. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=operasi).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认出 operasi“运作／行动／手术”，再把 -nya 当作回指箭头：前面说的是谁或什么，就理解为其相关的 operasi。

etymology.historical_story: Obses belongs to the international vocabulary associated with obsession. Its Malaysian dictionary history shows how reference works change: older DBP advice directed users to obsesi, while a 2025 answer explicitly recognized obses as an adjective in Kamus Dewan Perdana. This establishes its modern lexical status without establishing an exact borrowing date or transmission route.

etymology.historical_story: English orb comes from Latin orbis, meaning a ring or circle. Its later meanings include spherical objects and the ceremonial globe carried by a sovereign. The royal object connects a simple geometric shape with political authority. DBP retains orb as the Malay equivalent specifically for this regalia sense. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/orb)、[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=sphere)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把字母 o 想成圆球，再想象球顶立着十字架：orb，王权宝球。

etymology.historical_story: Oxford began as a practical place name: Old English oxna referred to oxen, and ford meant a place where a river could be crossed. The name therefore recalls cattle crossing shallow water. In Malay, this historical English formation is retained as a complete proper name, rather than analyzed as Malay morphology. [Source: Ashmolean Museum](https://anglosaxondiscovery.ashmus.ox.ac.uk/Life/settlement/placenames.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Oxford＝牛津：ox 是牛，ford 是浅水渡口；想象牛群涉水过河。

etymology.historical_story: Ohio took its name from the river associated with the region. The Ohio Auditor of State traces that river name to an Indigenous Iroquoian expression rendered as 'great water'; the National Park Service gives 'great river'. Malay uses the established place name as a whole, rather than translating or dividing it into Malay morphemes.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按英语读音记成“欧—嗨—欧”，中间的“嗨”重读；把整串声音与美国地图上的俄亥俄州联系起来，不拆成马来语词根。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语词，不按马来语词缀分析；词中的 th 通常读浊齿擦音 /ð/。音节与音标均为英语信息。因不宜将英语输入项认定为正式马来语词目，status 标为 non_malay。

senses.zh_definition: 其他的、别的；指不同于已提到或当前所指的人或事物。此为英语用法。
senses.en_definition: Different from the person or thing already mentioned or considered.
senses.ms_definition: Perkataan bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud lain atau yang berlainan daripada orang atau benda yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 英语语法中此用法常归为限定词；这里依所给词性选项采用传统的 adjective 标注。正式马来语通常用 lain 或 yang lain。[DBP：英语 other 的马来语对应](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=selain)。

senses.zh_definition: 另外的、其余的；指除已列出者以外的项目或成员。此为英语用法。
senses.en_definition: Additional to, or remaining apart from, those already specified.
senses.ms_definition: Perkataan bahasa Inggeris yang merujuk kepada perkara tambahan atau perkara selebihnya selain yang telah dinyatakan.

senses.zh_definition: 另一个；其余的人或事物。英语中常见形式为 the other 或 others。
senses.en_definition: The remaining person or thing, or different people or things.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan bahasa Inggeris, seorang atau sesuatu yang satu lagi, atau orang dan benda yang lain.
senses.nuances: 这是英语的名词性用法；现代语法也可作代词或融合限定结构分析。泛指“别人”通常用 others，不用裸词 other。[DBP：orang lain](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=orang+lain)。

etymology.historical_story: English other continues Old English oþer, which expressed meanings including second, additional and different. Its occurrence in a Malay-oriented word list does not by itself establish a Malay borrowing: English forms and quoted interface labels can also enter source texts. For Malay learning, connect it with lain, yang lain or lain-lain according to context. [词源资料：other](https://www.etymonline.com/word/other)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: other＝“别的”：other people → orang lain；表单选项 Other → Lain-lain。把英语标签与马来语表达成对记忆。

etymology.historical_story: Olaf belongs to a Scandinavian naming tradition documented in medieval sources. PASE connects it with Old Norse Óláfr and older related forms, whose elements refer to ancestry and inheritance or descent. Medieval English records preserve differing spellings, including Onlaf. This history explains the name's background without identifying any particular modern bearer. [Source: PASE](https://pase.ac.uk/domesday/name/2251/).

senses.zh_definition: 希望实现的具体目标或预期成果。
senses.en_definition: A specific aim or result that someone intends to achieve.
senses.ms_definition: Sasaran atau hasil tertentu yang hendak dicapai melalui sesuatu tindakan atau kegiatan.
senses.nuances: 常用于研究、教学、项目和组织规划，强调可明确陈述的目标。此处为名词，与表示“客观的”的形容词义项不同。义项依据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=103260&keyword=objektif)，释义为编写性转述。

senses.zh_definition: 以实际情况和可核实的事实为依据的；客观的。
senses.en_definition: Based on facts and actual conditions.
senses.ms_definition: Berlandaskan fakta serta keadaan sebenar yang dapat diperiksa.
senses.nuances: 强调分析或说明有事实依据，常见于研究、报道和工作评估；与个人感受主导的 subjektif 相对。

senses.zh_definition: 不受个人情绪、偏见或利害立场左右的；公正客观的。
senses.en_definition: Not influenced by personal feelings or prejudice.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak berat sebelah akibat perasaan, kepentingan atau prasangka peribadi.
senses.nuances: 强调判断者的公正性，与前一义项的“事实依据”相关，但侧重点不同；态度冷静本身并不保证判断客观。

senses.zh_definition: 指试题或测验具有确定答案、依据统一标准评分的；客观题式的。
senses.en_definition: Of a test or question, scored against predetermined answers rather than an examiner's personal judgment.
senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan soalan atau ujian yang mempunyai jawapan tertentu dan pemarkahan berasaskan skema tetap.
senses.nuances: 教育语境中的专门用法；马来西亚学校常用它指选择题形式。这里描述题型和评分方式，并非声称题目内容绝无偏差。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 职场中宜说 Mari kita menilai perkara ini secara objektif（我们来客观评估这件事），以共同任务的口吻提出要求；直接说 Awak tidak objektif 容易被理解为指责。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合会议、学术讨论、教学和绩效评估。涉及个人遭遇时，应先承认对方的感受，再提出核实事实的需要。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 职场中宜说 Mari kita menilai perkara ini secara objektif（我们来客观评估这件事），以共同任务的口吻提出要求；直接说 Awak tidak objektif 容易被理解为指责。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合会议、学术讨论、教学和绩效评估。涉及个人遭遇时，应先承认对方的感受，再提出核实事实的需要。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies English as the source language of objektif. Malay adapted the spelling while retaining two useful meanings: an aim to achieve and a judgment grounded in facts. A project can therefore have an objektif, while its results should be assessed secara objektif. The shared spelling links planning with fair evaluation. Source: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=103260&keyword=objektif).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 objektif 与英语 objective 成对记忆：一个是“要达到的目标”，另一个是“看事实的客观态度”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + Oracle → Oracle（外来专名，整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 作为公司或产品名称时不作马来语词缀拆分，规范写作 Oracle；词条键保留输入小写。IPA 采用常见英式英语读音，不表示已确定唯一的马来西亚本地读法。

senses.zh_definition: 甲骨文公司：提供数据库、云计算及企业软件等产品与服务的科技企业。
senses.en_definition: Oracle, a technology company providing database software, cloud services and enterprise applications.
senses.ms_definition: Oracle, sebuah syarikat teknologi yang menyediakan perisian pangkalan data, perkhidmatan awan dan aplikasi perusahaan.
senses.nuances: 这是专有名词 nama khas，通常大写。公司与产品的解释根据其[官方网站](https://www.oracle.com/corporate/)编写，非 DBP 官方释义。输入没有上下文，不能确定此义就是原始语料中的所指。英语普通名词 oracle 另有神谕、传达神谕者或权威消息来源等含义，不能直接据此认定为马来语普通词。status 沿用所要求的条目标签，不表示 DBP 已认证此词条。

senses.zh_definition: Oracle 数据库：Oracle Database 的语境性简称，指甲骨文公司的数据库管理系统。
senses.en_definition: Oracle Database, referred to contextually by the shortened name Oracle.
senses.ms_definition: Sebutan ringkas mengikut konteks bagi Oracle Database, iaitu sistem pengurusan pangkalan data keluaran Oracle.
senses.nuances: 职场口语中的 guna Oracle 或 sistem Oracle 可能指数据库，也可能指其他 Oracle 产品。技术文件宜首次写明 Oracle Database 或具体产品名称。[Oracle 官方网站](https://www.oracle.com/corporate/)列有其数据库与云服务业务。

etymology.historical_story: Oracle’s corporate history begins in 1977, when Larry Ellison, Bob Miner and Ed Oates founded Software Development Laboratories. The company’s timeline records its adoption of the Oracle name in 1982. etymology.historical_story: English orange preserves a long borrowing chain: Sanskrit nāraṅga passed through Persian and Arabic, then through southern French and Anglo-French forms before reaching English. etymology.historical_story: The company name preserves the surname of Elisha Graves Otis. In 1853, he sold his first elevator after developing a safety brake. The following year, he demonstrated the mechanism in New York by having the supporting rope cut. The brake stopped the platform, giving the name a memorable association with elevator safety.

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留独立词根标记；在本条有据可查的用法中，它是 operasi 的缩写，不是加缀派生。行动名称中常写 Op 或 OP。/op/ 表示按单音节读出的形式，实际也可展开读作 operasi。

senses.zh_definition: 行动、专项行动；operasi 的缩写，尤其见于警方、军方或其他执法机关的行动名称。
senses.en_definition: An abbreviation of operasi, especially in the name of a police, military, or enforcement operation.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan bagi operasi, khususnya dalam nama kegiatan terancang yang dijalankan oleh pasukan keselamatan atau penguat kuasa.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚官方材料确有 Op 用法，如 Op Mabuk、Op Samseng Jalanan。DBP 的语言咨询同时指出，行动名称也常用 OPS。这里收录有官方实际用例支持的缩写义，并非声称存在已核实的独立马来语词头定义。英语 op 的“手术”义及网络 OP 的其他展开形式，不能直接并入本义。[警方用例](https://www.rmp.gov.my/news-detail/2015/08/06/tujuh-kereta-dua-motosikal-ditahan-dalam-tiga-operasi-di-labuan)，[DBP 缩写用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=op)。

etymology.historical_story: In Malaysian enforcement writing, Op functions as a shortened form of operasi and commonly introduces an operation's name. Police publications provide examples such as Op Mabuk and Op Samseng Jalanan. This naming practice explains the form without treating it as an affixed word. Its meaning must be distinguished from unrelated English and internet abbreviations with the same letters.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 operasi 的开头 op 圈出来：看到 Op 加行动名称，就联想到“专项行动”；它不是需要拆词缀的普通长词。

etymology.historical_story: Oogway belongs to the naming world of Kung Fu Panda rather than to Malay derivational vocabulary. A DreamWorks exhibition resource identifies Grand Master Oogway as the figure who chooses Po as the Dragon Warrior. In Malay discussion, the name identifies that character; it does not become the ordinary Malay word for a tortoise. [DreamWorks exhibition resource](https://www.marinabaysands.com/content/dam/singapore/marinabaysands/master/main/home/museum/school-activities/DreamWorksVETAnimationEducationResource.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Oogway 的近似读音“乌—归”与乌龟大师的形象绑定；这是记忆联想，不是马来语构词或词源证明。

senses.zh_definition: 沙漠中有水源、土地肥沃并能生长植物的地区；绿洲。
senses.en_definition: A fertile area in a desert where water is available.
senses.ms_definition: Kawasan yang subur dan mempunyai air di padang pasir; wahah.
senses.nuances: 指真实的沙漠地理环境，不泛指所有水边绿地。wahah 是同义词；此处采用数据包所载《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》释义。

senses.zh_definition: 比喻在喧嚣、困顿或单调环境中提供宁静、慰藉或生机的地方。
senses.en_definition: A place offering peace, relief, or renewal amid difficult surroundings.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, tempat yang memberikan ketenangan atau kelegaan dalam suasana yang mencabar.
senses.nuances: 这是基于绿洲意象的修辞引申，不是数据包中单独列出的 DBP 义项。常用于旅游、生活方式及文学描写；正式地理说明应采用本义。

etymology.historical_story: The word's distant history leads to ancient Egypt, where watered desert settlements supported farming and travel. Greek adopted the Egyptian geographical name, helping carry it into a wider vocabulary. Ancient oases supplied dates and grapes and connected trade routes. That combination of water, settlement, and survival explains the enduring image of refuge. [Global Egyptian Museum](https://www.globalegyptianmuseum.org/glossary.aspx?id=276), [Oxford Classical Dictionary](https://academic.oup.com/edited-volume/61673/chapter-abstract/549686857).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 跟读 o-a-sis，想象穿过黄沙后惊呼“哦！”，眼前出现水源和绿地；这是场景联想，不是词源拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根以元音 o 开头。派生时 meN- 在元音前实现为 meng-，保留整个词根：meng- + obor → mengobor。

senses.zh_definition: 火把；以燃烧的火焰提供照明、通常可以手持的器具。
senses.en_definition: A torch that provides light through a burning flame.
senses.ms_definition: Jamung; suluh yang bernyala.
senses.nuances: 本义指有火焰的火把。现代手电筒通常叫 lampu suluh；不能因为英语 torch 也可指手电筒，就把两者混同。obor Olimpik 指奥林匹克火炬。[DBP：obor](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=obor+)

senses.zh_definition: 比喻给予启迪、指引方向或鼓舞精神的人、思想或力量。
senses.en_definition: A figurative source of enlightenment, guidance, or inspiration.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, sesuatu atau seseorang yang memberikan penerangan dan petunjuk.
senses.nuances: 由照亮道路引申为精神或思想上的引导，适合演讲、教育和文学语境。DBP 的机构歌曲也采用火炬意象；这证明其文化用法，并不证明该词的最早来源。[DBP：Obor Semangat Nan Abadi](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2025/06/26/18963/)

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary records both the physical torch and its figurative role as a guide. That pairing gives obor a cultural life beyond fire: light becomes an image of knowledge, direction, and collective spirit. DBP's institutional song uses this imagery too. This is a documented account of meaning and cultural use; the consulted evidence does not establish the word's ultimate linguistic origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个 o 想成两团火光，中间的 b 像火把柄：obor 是照亮道路的火把，也能比喻照亮思想。

morphology.pattern_note: 可理解为拉长感叹声的重复字母写法，不是马来语词缀派生，也不是标准重叠构词。is_root 沿用输入标记，不表示已确认为规范词根；没有固定标准读音。

senses.en_definition: An informal elongated reaction spelling, often conveying 'oh' or 'I see', with interpretation dependent on context.
senses.ms_definition: Huraian editorial, bukan takrif rasmi DBP: ejaan reaksi tidak baku dalam perbualan bertulis yang boleh menyatakan bahawa seseorang baru memahami sesuatu atau memberikan respons seperti oh.

etymology.historical_story: In informal digital writing, repeated letters can suggest a drawn-out voice or an expressive response. The string ooo can be interpreted this way when the conversation supports an 'oh' reading. This is a contextual account of its spelling, not a documented etymology: neither the packet nor the cited DBP guidance establishes a standardized Malay headword ooo.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 三个 o 像把“哦——”拉长；记住的是聊天语气，不是三个音节，也不是固定词义。

etymology.historical_story: Olah illustrates how identical spellings can organise different parts of a dictionary. Kamus Dewan separates olah I, covering ways, deeds and antics, from olah II, the base associated with processing and reshaping. The first connects with berolah and seolah-olah; the second with mengolah and pengolahan. This distinction offers a reliable cultural and lexical story without inventing a single historical origin for both entries.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 olah 记成“摆弄”：摆弄材料是加工，摆弄主意是构思，摆弄脾气是耍花样。这只是记忆桥梁，不代表两个同形词必有共同词源。

senses.zh_definition: 生物；有机体。能够进行生命活动的个体，包括动物、植物及其他生命形式。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies organisma as an English borrowing. Its ending illustrates a documented Malay terminology convention: English words ending in the consonant cluster -sm can acquire a final a. This adaptation makes organism into organisma, a term that connects familiar animals and plants with microscopic life within one scientific category. [DBP terminology discussion](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/rampak.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: The supplied Kamus Dewan entry labels this opén as Jakarta usage. It records both careful attentiveness and a tendency to collect neglected objects, alongside the verb mengopeni. This regional record should be kept distinct from English open in mixed-language conversation. The entry does not establish an earlier donor language or borrowing date, so a more specific origin story would be speculative. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=open)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 o.pén 想成两个动作：先“留心看”，再“捡起来”。记住细心与捡拾两个地区义；é 发 /e/，别顺手读成英语 open。

etymology.historical_story: OCP illustrates how English initialisms circulate within Malaysia’s multilingual professional settings. Health Ministry materials use it for oral contraceptive pill, while trade ministry materials use it for operational certification procedures. These are separate abbreviations sharing the same letters, rather than meanings demonstrably developed from one Malay root. The supplied packet does not establish which abbreviation produced this corpus token.

etymology.historical_story: Obsesi belongs to an international word family ultimately associated with Latin obsessiō, meaning a siege or blockade. That image offers a memorable bridge to a thought that keeps occupying the mind. The Indonesian form is traced through Dutch obsessie; this does not by itself establish the immediate borrowing route into Malaysian Malay. [Etymological comparison](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/obsesi)

etymology.historical_story: DBP's encyclopedia links otto with minyak atar, placing the unfamiliar label within the craft of extracting fragrance from flowers. etymology.historical_story: Own belongs to the inherited English vocabulary of possession. Its adjective continues Old English āgen, while its verb developed within the same historical family of having and possessing. etymology.historical_story: Orang tua combines ordinary Malay words meaning person and old. Beyond describing age, the expression also refers to parents and experienced community elders. These established meanings connect seniority with family relationships and social experience. Malaysian standard spelling preserves a space between the components; the joined input orangtua should therefore be normalized before publication as a standard Malay headword. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=orang+tua).

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 正式介绍可用 bekas Presiden Amerika Syarikat, Barack Obama；后文可用 Obama 或尊称代词 beliau。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于新闻、历史和政治讨论。专名本身不表达政治立场；避免将它解释成马来语普通词，或根据姓氏推断个人宗教及观点。

etymology.historical_story: Obama enters Malay here as a personal surname, not as a newly formed Malay common noun. Barack Obama, whose father was Kenyan, became the forty-fourth president of the United States. His surname consequently appears in discussions of American politics. Its spelling should be learned whole, without inventing Malay prefixes or suffixes.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: obama 对应熟悉的人名“奥巴马”；词表键可用小写，写进句子时记得大写 Obama。

morphology.formula: ∅ + oooh → oooh；对应规范感叹词 oh 的拉长拼写
morphology.pattern_note: 重复字母表示声音或情绪延长，不是词缀，也不是构词重叠。[oː] 为示意读音，实际元音、时长与语调随说话者和语境变化。保留输入的独立词根标记，不代表它是规范词根。

senses.zh_definition: 哦；噢；表示听到解释后明白、认出或恍然大悟的拉长感叹声。
senses.en_definition: An elongated informal interjection expressing realization, recognition, or understanding.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk ejaan tidak formal bagi kata seru oh yang dipanjangkan untuk menandakan bahawa penutur baru memahami atau mengenali sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 实际词类为 kata seru（感叹词），此处按给定分类归入 particle。规范对应形式为 oh；oooh 不应标为官方规范拼写。这里的马来文释义为编辑撰写，并非 DBP 原文。DBP 收录 oh 表示惊讶、疑惑、失望或确信等反应。[DBP：oh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=oh)。以下为自然话语组合，不是固定搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 噢；哇；表示惊讶、赞叹或其他受语调影响的情绪反应。
senses.en_definition: An elongated informal exclamation expressing surprise, admiration, or another context-dependent reaction.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk kata seru oh yang dipanjangkan untuk melahirkan rasa terkejut, hairan, kagum atau reaksi emosi lain mengikut konteks dan intonasi.
senses.nuances: 不能仅凭重复字母判断是赞美、失望还是讽刺；须结合后文、标点和语调。情绪范围参照规范形式 oh。[DBP：oh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=oh)。以下为示例性话语组合。

dual_scenarios.context: 研究报告 / 访谈转录说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam transkrip temu bual ini, ejaan tidak formal 'oooh' dikekalkan untuk menggambarkan reaksi spontan responden.
dual_scenarios.zh: 本访谈转录保留非正式拼写“oooh”，以呈现受访者的即时反应。
dual_scenarios.en: In this interview transcript, the informal spelling 'oooh' is retained to convey the respondent's spontaneous reaction.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友解释见面地点
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: oooh, kat kedai sebelah bank tu je! Patutlah aku tak jumpa tadi.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Oh, di kedai di sebelah bank itu sahaja! Patutlah saya tidak menjumpainya tadi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 哦，就在银行旁边那家店啊！难怪我刚才没找到。
dual_scenarios.en: Oh, just at the shop next to the bank! No wonder I couldn't find it earlier.
spoken_features: oooh 用重复字母表现拉长的恍然大悟声，规范拼写为 oh
kat 对应 di；tu 对应 itu；je 对应 sahaja
朋友间使用 aku；tak 对应 tidak

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah sampai kat kedai sebelah bank tu. Kau kat mana?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah sampai di kedai di sebelah bank itu. Awak di mana?
messages.zh: 我已经到银行旁边那家店了。你在哪儿？
messages.en: I'm already at the shop next to the bank. Where are you?

messages.ms_spoken: oooh, kat situ je! Aku ingat kedai depan bank. Tunggu jap, aku datang.
messages.ms_standard: Oh, di situ sahaja! Saya sangka kedai di hadapan bank. Tunggu sebentar, saya akan datang.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适合熟人聊天。单独回复 oooh 可能显得敷衍或带讽刺；对上司、客户或长辈，回复“Baik, saya faham. Terima kasih.”通常更明确得体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式公文宜使用规范拼写或直接写明理解、惊讶的内容；转录、引语和语言研究可保留 oooh。没有固有禁忌，但不宜用夸张语气回应他人的坏消息。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 适合熟人聊天。单独回复 oooh 可能显得敷衍或带讽刺；对上司、客户或长辈，回复“Baik, saya faham. Terima kasih.”通常更明确得体。

etymology.historical_story: This spelling illustrates how online writers represent a drawn-out exclamation through repeated letters. A 2012 study of Malaysian online texts explicitly included oooh when discussing normalization of expressive letter repetition. It documents digital usage rather than an independent historical root; the corresponding standard Malay interjection is oh. [Malaysian online-text study](https://repo.uum.edu.my/id/eprint/10933/1/CR204.pdf); [DBP: oh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=oh).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 o 想成张圆的嘴：oooh，就是把“哦——原来如此”的声音拉长。字母更多，情绪更明显，不是音节更多。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入作为独立词形处理，不拆成马来语词缀。若指日语 oishii，sh 对应日语音 [ɕ]，末尾元音为长音；所列 IPA 是该日语原词的读音，非已核实的马来语标准读音。

senses.zh_definition: 好吃的；美味的。此解释以该词指日语 oishii 的非规范罗马字写法为前提，不能据此认定它是正式马来语词条。
senses.en_definition: Delicious or tasty, if intended as an informal spelling of Japanese oishii used in code-switching.
senses.ms_definition: Sedap rasanya; tafsiran ini merujuk kepada kata Jepun oishii yang digunakan dalam pertuturan bercampur bahasa, bukan takrif rasmi DBP bagi ejaan oishi.
senses.nuances: 输入没有提供释义或用例，因此这里采用日语 oishii 的解释，保留待核实状态。日本国际交流基金列出的形式是 oishii，意为 delicious/tasty，不能据此证明 oishi 已成为马来语规范借词。Oishi 也可能是品牌或专名，须按上下文判断。以下搭配为示范性的混语表达，未经频率验证。[日语原词与释义](https://marugoto.jpf.go.jp/assets/docs/download/starter_c/MarugotoStarterCompetencesVocabularyIndex_EN.pdf)

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 外语词语说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam bahasa Jepun, kata yang kadangkala ditulis sebagai “oishi” dieja “oishii” dalam tulisan Rumi dan bermaksud “sedap”.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在日语中，有时被写作“oishi”的这个词，其罗马字形式为“oishii”，意思是“好吃”。
dual_scenarios.en: The Japanese word sometimes written as “oishi” is romanized as “oishii” and means “delicious”.

lah 加强赞叹语气；nak 对应 mahu。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于轻松的美食交流或明确标示的外语引用。不要把这一拼写介绍为已获 DBP 认可的正式马来语，也不要把品牌名 Oishi 一律翻译成“好吃”。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 朋友间谈日本料理时可以用日语表达增加亲切感；面对不熟悉日语的人，直接说 sedap 更清楚。正式马来语写作中宜用 sedap 或 enak。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于轻松的美食交流或明确标示的外语引用。不要把这一拼写介绍为已获 DBP 认可的正式马来语，也不要把品牌名 Oishi 一律翻译成“好吃”。

etymology.historical_story: The likely reference is Japanese oishii, written おいしい and meaning delicious or tasty. The Japan Foundation teaches that spelling in its beginner vocabulary. In a Malay sentence, oishi can therefore be interpreted as a Japanese expression inserted into conversation. Without an original usage example, however, its identity as this adjective rather than a name or brand remains uncertain. [Source](https://marugoto.jpf.go.jp/assets/docs/download/starter_c/MarugotoStarterCompetencesVocabularyIndex_EN.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 联想吃到美食时说“哦，一试就喜欢！”来记“好吃”；这只是记忆联想。日语原词 oishii 的末尾 i 要延长。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是第二人称领属附着代词，并非派生词缀；suffix 仅表示其后接位置。词根不变，读音据词根 /o.taʔ/ 加 /mu/ 推定。输入的 اوتق 只拼写 otak；此处 اوتقمو 为加接 -mu 的规则性拼写，非独立词头的官方引文。

senses.zh_definition: 你的脑：指受话者颅内作为神经系统中枢的器官。
senses.en_definition: Your brain: the organ inside your skull that serves as the central organ of the nervous system.
senses.ms_definition: Otak yang dimiliki oleh orang yang disapa; kata dasar otak ditakrifkan sebagai “organ di bahagian atas kepala, yg mengawal pemikiran (perasaan), benak”.
senses.nuances: 整个词仍为名词，-mu 表示第二人称领属。马来语定义前半为组合式释义，后半引自输入提供的 DBP 词根释义；不是声称 DBP 为 otakmu 另立词头。official 表示其采用规范词根和附着代词构式。见 [PRPM：otak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=otak) 及 [DBP 拼写指南](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 你的头脑、思维或思考能力；以脑这一器官转指受话者的心智活动。
senses.en_definition: Your mind or thinking ability, with the brain standing figuratively for thought and reasoning.
senses.ms_definition: Daya berfikir, akal atau fikiran orang yang disapa; berdasarkan makna kiasan kata dasar otak, iaitu alat berfikir atau fikiran.
senses.nuances: 这是词根 otak 的比喻义加领属 -mu，并非“你的脑子有问题”之类贬义。语气取决于句子：鼓励思考可以友善，命令 Gunakan otakmu! 则可能显得训斥。词根的心智义见 [PRPM：otak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=otak)。

dual_scenarios.context: 教育活动报道；引述面向学生的宣传语
dual_scenarios.ms: Program pendidikan itu menggunakan slogan “Asah otakmu, kembangkan potensimu” untuk menggalakkan murid berfikir secara kreatif.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该教育活动采用“磨炼你的头脑，开发你的潜能”这一标语，鼓励学生发挥创意思考。
dual_scenarios.en: The educational programme uses the slogan “Sharpen your mind, develop your potential” to encourage pupils to think creatively.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -mu 的亲疏和语气取决于关系与文体；在诗歌、歌词、标语中自然，在正式服务或对长辈讲话时宜按对象改用 otak anda、fikiran tuan 等表达。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 讨论思考能力时要注意语气。对不熟悉的人直接说 Gunakan otakmu! 容易被理解为责骂；可改成 Mari kita fikirkan bersama，表示一起思考。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -mu 的亲疏和语气取决于关系与文体；在诗歌、歌词、标语中自然，在正式服务或对长辈讲话时宜按对象改用 otak anda、fikiran tuan 等表达。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 讨论思考能力时要注意语气。对不熟悉的人直接说 Gunakan otakmu! 容易被理解为责骂；可改成 Mari kita fikirkan bersama，表示一起思考。

etymology.historical_story: Otakmu combines the noun otak with the bound second-person pronoun -mu. DBP records both the physical brain and the figurative faculty of thought under otak. Malay spelling joins mu to the preceding word, so this form expresses possession through an attached pronoun rather than through a separate possessive word. [Sources: PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=otak), [DBP spelling guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 otak＝脑，再把 mu 当作“你的”小标签：otak＋mu＝你的脑；换成 ku，就是“我的脑”。

morphology.formula: oh + my + God → O + M + G → omg
morphology.pattern_note: 英语短语的首字母缩写，通常逐字母读出；不是马来语加缀词。is_root 在此仅表示作为不可再作马来语词缀分析的输入单位处理。

senses.zh_definition: “天哪！”：英语 oh my God 的非正式缩写，用于表达惊讶、震惊或兴奋，也可嵌入马来语网络交流。
senses.en_definition: An informal initialism of ‘oh my God’, expressing surprise, shock, or excitement.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan tidak formal bagi ungkapan Inggeris oh my God yang digunakan untuk menyatakan rasa terkejut atau teruja; huraian ini bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 实际功能为感叹表达，相当于 kata seru；因给定词性枚举没有 interjection，此处暂归 particle。小写 omg 与大写 OMG 在该用法中意义相同。下列项目为马来语夹用缩写的反应短语示例，不是已验证的固定搭配或频率统计。参考：[Oxford 的 OMG 词条](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/omg)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Laporan tersebut meneliti penggunaan singkatan ‘omg’ untuk menyatakan rasa terkejut dalam mesej tidak formal.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该报告研究了非正式消息中用缩写“omg”表达惊讶的现象。
dual_scenarios.en: The report examines the use of ‘omg’ to express surprise in informal messages.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)

etymology.historical_story: OMG compresses the English exclamation oh my God into three initial letters. Its compact written form suits messages that need a quick emotional reaction. The letters can also be pronounced separately, allowing the written abbreviation to function in speech. This English formation does not involve a Malay root or affix. Reference: [Oxford pronunciation and meaning](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/omg).

etymology.historical_story: The mythological name Odin continues Old Norse Óðinn, with related Germanic forms such as Woden and Wotan. Its linguistic background involves inspiration and frenzy, fitting a deity associated with poetry as well as war. These connections explain the historical name; they do not establish the intended referent of an isolated corpus token or the naming motive of a software project. [Name history](https://thetroth.org/resource/odin/)

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies orkestra as an English borrowing. Its deeper ancestor is Greek orkhēstra, the space where a theatre's chorus danced and sang. Over time, the name of a performance space became the name of the musicians associated with it. The modern Malay word therefore carries a journey from an ancient stage to a coordinated instrumental ensemble. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=orkestra); [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/orchestra).

etymology.historical_story: Oscorp is a fictional corporate name from Spider-Man storytelling, associated with Norman Osborn. Its narrative role connects industrial wealth and advanced technology with the conflicts surrounding Spider-Man and the Green Goblin. The name travels into Malay through discussion of comics and films, retaining its identity as a company name rather than becoming an ordinary Malay noun.

etymology.historical_story: Ozzy is a spelling variant of Ozzie, a familiar form associated with names such as Oswald and Osborn. Nicknames can also arise from surnames: the musician Ozzy Osbourne's nickname is an example. Consequently, the spelling alone does not establish a bearer's full name, ancestry, or intended name meaning. [Ozzy](https://www.behindthename.com/name/ozzy), [Ozzie](https://www.behindthename.com/name/ozzie)

etymology.historical_story: DBP records oh as a Malay interjection for reactions including surprise, disappointment and becoming convinced. The spelling ohhh represents an expressive extension of that form in informal writing. Think of the extra letters as a way of putting a drawn-out voice onto a screen. They add conversational expression rather than a new grammatical ending or a separate historical root. [DBP: oh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=oh)

etymology.historical_story: Otsutsuki is a Japanese fictional name encountered through Naruto and its related works. The official Japanese episode page writes it 大筒木 and supplies the reading おおつつき; its English counterpart uses Otsutsuki. The spelling Ōtsutsuki makes the initial long vowel explicit. etymology.historical_story: Oregon has a documented naming history but a debated ultimate origin. A 1765 proposal by Robert Rogers used Ouragon for a western river; the spelling Oregon appeared in Jonathan Carver's 1778 book. The name later became associated with a wider region and the state. An Algonquian origin has scholarly support, but should remain identified as a proposal. Sources: [Oregon Legislature](https://www.oregonlegislature.gov/Documents/FunFacts.pdf), [Goddard and Love](https://www.ohs.org/oregon-historical-quarterly/upload/OHQ_105_2-Goddard-Love-Oregon-the-Beautiful.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Malaysian institutional usage gives ops a practical identity as a shortened label for an organised operation. DBP advice records its use in programme names such as Ops Selamat. senses.ms_definition: Orang yang berada dalam kumpulan saya, bekerja untuk saya atau bertindak bagi pihak saya.
senses.nuances: 这是 orang 与 -ku 的组合义，并非已核实的独立 DBP 词条。通常指自己的人手或同伴；不能脱离语境直接译成“我的爱人”。orang 可依语境指一人或多人。构词依据：[DBP：ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=ku)；词义依据：[DBP：orang 的同义分类](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=orang-orangan)。

collocations.zh: 我的一名手下或团队成员

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻报道中的直接引语；公文通常改用 anggota pasukan saya
dual_scenarios.ms: Ketua pasukan itu berkata, "Semua orangku telah menerima arahan keselamatan."
dual_scenarios.zh: 那名队长说：“我的所有队员都已收到安全指示。”
dual_scenarios.en: The team leader said, "All my people have received the safety instructions."

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 熟悉的同事之间协调人手
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Orangku dah sampai kat sana, tunggu je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Anggota pasukan saya sudah tiba di sana; tunggu sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我的人已经到那边了，等着就行。
dual_scenarios.en: My people are already there. Just wait.
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语形式
kat 此处对应 di
je 对应 sahaja
orangku 带熟人之间较直接的团队归属口吻；orang aku 也常见

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Orangku dah sampai kat pintu belakang. Nak suruh masuk sekarang?
messages.ms_standard: Anggota pasukan saya sudah tiba di pintu belakang. Adakah saya perlu menyuruh mereka masuk sekarang?
messages.zh: 我的人已经到后门了。现在叫他们进去吗？
messages.en: My team is at the back entrance. Shall I send them in now?

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Suruh tunggu kejap ya, aku nak buka pintu.
messages.ms_standard: Minta mereka menunggu sebentar, ya. Saya hendak membuka pintu.
messages.zh: 叫他们稍等一下哈，我去开门。
messages.en: Ask them to wait a moment. I'll open the door.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -ku 与 aku 属于较亲近或文学性的第一人称表达。向客户、长辈或上级介绍团队时，anggota pasukan saya 通常更稳妥。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈自己的人手时可用，但语气可能显得强调上下级或阵营。指伴侣时须有明确关系语境，避免让人感到被占有。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -ku 与 aku 属于较亲近或文学性的第一人称表达。向客户、长辈或上级介绍团队时，anggota pasukan saya 通常更稳妥。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 谈自己的人手时可用，但语气可能显得强调上下级或阵营。指伴侣时须有明确关系语境，避免让人感到被占有。

etymology.historical_story: This form is best understood through Malay grammar rather than a separate borrowing story. Orang supplies the idea of a person or people, while bound -ku represents aku. Together they place those people in the speaker's personal sphere. The relationship may involve a team, an assignment, or allegiance; the form itself does not specify romance.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: orang 是“人”，-ku 是“我的”：把两块拼起来，就是“我的人”。

morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的后附形式，与介词 oleh 连写，不发生音变；oleh 中的 e 为 /e/。输入包的 اوليه 只拼出词基 oleh，完整形式按 اوليه + کو 补为 اوليهکو。这里 suffix 表示附着位置，实际语法身份为人称附着语。[DBP 连写规则](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 由我；表示某个动作的施事是“我”。
senses.en_definition: By me, identifying the first-person agent of an action.
senses.ms_definition: Oleh aku; menunjukkan aku sebagai pelaku sesuatu perbuatan.
senses.nuances: 完整形式相当于介词短语 oleh aku。马来西亚规范语法中，普通第一人称被动句通常写 surat itu saya tulis 或 surat itu kutulis；不宜机械套用 di-... olehku。ter- 被动结构可接第一人称，例如 tidak terangkat olehku。[DBP 被动句说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ter+oleh)

senses.zh_definition: 因我；表示某种状态或结果由我引起。
senses.en_definition: Because of me; through my action or influence.
senses.ms_definition: Disebabkan oleh aku atau akibat perbuatanku.
senses.nuances: 与施事义相邻，具体译法取决于动词和语境。此类 olehku 表达偏文学；日常解释原因更常用 kerana aku 或 sebab aku。以下为语义组合例，不代表完整词形的已核实高频搭配。[DBP 对 oleh 的原因义说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=oleh)

senses.zh_definition: 被我感知到；表示“我”是看见、听见等感知活动的体验者。
senses.en_definition: By me as the perceiver or experiencer.
senses.ms_definition: Menunjukkan aku sebagai pihak yang melihat, mendengar atau mengalami sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常见于叙述或文学语体中的感知结构；terlihat olehku 是“被我看见”，不是“属于我”。普通口语可改为 aku nampak 或 aku dengar。此义与 oleh 表示感知者的用法相通。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=oleh)

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻报道 / 引述个人记录
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam catatan peribadinya, pegawai itu menulis, "Peti yang berat itu tidak terangkat olehku seorang diri."
dual_scenarios.zh: 那名官员在个人记录中写道：“那只沉重的箱子，我一个人搬不起来。”
dual_scenarios.en: In a personal account, the officer wrote, "I could not lift the heavy crate on my own."

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友间略带夸张的求助
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Peti ni tak terangkat olehku lah, berat sangat! Tolong kejap.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Peti ini tidak terangkat olehku kerana terlalu berat. Tolonglah sebentar.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这箱子我真搬不动啦，太重了！来搭把手。
dual_scenarios.en: I can't lift this crate—it's way too heavy! Give me a hand.
spoken_features: ni 对应 ini；tak 对应 tidak。
lah 加强抱怨和求助语气；kejap 对应 sebentar。
olehku 在此是熟人间故意使用的书面化表达；普通口语更常说 aku tak larat angkat peti ni。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Peti ni tak terangkat olehku lah, berat sangat! Kau dah sampai ke?
messages.ms_standard: Peti ini tidak terangkat olehku kerana terlalu berat. Adakah kamu sudah sampai?
messages.zh: 这箱子我真搬不动啦，太重了！你到了没？
messages.en: I can't lift this crate—it's way too heavy! Are you here yet?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, aku kat bawah je. Tunggu, kita angkat sama-sama.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, saya berada di bawah. Tunggu sebentar; kita angkat bersama-sama.
messages.zh: 到了，我就在楼下。等一下，咱们一起搬。
messages.en: Yes, I'm just downstairs. Hang on—we'll lift it together.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -ku 具有 aku 的亲密或文学语气，并不自动适用于正式职场交流。向上司或客户陈述自己的行动，通常直接使用 saya。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合个人叙述、诗歌和熟人间有意的书面化表达。公文中应先确定句法：例如“由我准备的报告”通常写 laporan yang saya sediakan，而非机械写成带 di- 和 olehku 的结构。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -ku 具有 aku 的亲密或文学语气，并不自动适用于正式职场交流。向上司或客户陈述自己的行动，通常直接使用 saya。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合个人叙述、诗歌和熟人间有意的书面化表达。公文中应先确定句法：例如“由我准备的报告”通常写 laporan yang saya sediakan，而非机械写成带 di- 和 olehku 的结构。

etymology.historical_story: Olehku combines the preposition oleh with ku, the shortened form of aku. Its compact spelling follows the Malay convention of attaching a shortened pronoun to the preceding word. The combination is especially useful in personal narration, where the speaker can appear as an agent or perceiver while another participant remains the focus of the sentence. [DBP spelling guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: oleh“由”＋-ku“我”＝“由我”；遇到 terlihat olehku，就顺成中文“我看见了”。

senses.zh_definition: 〈砂拉越口语〉洗衣粉。
senses.en_definition: In colloquial Sarawak Malay, washing powder.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam pertuturan Melayu Sarawak, serbuk pencuci pakaian.
senses.nuances: 此义见砂拉越社区词表，不能据此认定为 DBP 已核准的全国标准词；本条 status 按请求保留为 official，仅作条目标签，不表示官方语言认证。三语释义为编辑概括，搭配与例句为据此义编写的教学示例，未验证使用频次。[砂拉越社区词表](https://www.melayusarawak.dictionary.cecikut.com/?letter=o)

collocations.en: the washing powder has run out

dual_scenarios.context: 地方语言介绍 / 词汇说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Senarai kosa kata komuniti itu merekodkan “omo” sebagai sebutan setempat bagi serbuk pencuci pakaian di Sarawak.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该社区词表记录了“omo”在砂拉越当地指洗衣粉的用法。
dual_scenarios.en: The community word list records “omo” as a local Sarawak term for washing powder.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 熟悉砂拉越用语的室友安排采购
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Omo kat rumah dah habis, tolong beli satu pek ya.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Serbuk pencuci pakaian di rumah sudah habis. Tolong beli satu pek.
dual_scenarios.zh: 家里的洗衣粉用完了，帮忙买一包哦。
dual_scenarios.en: We’re out of washing powder at home. Please pick up a pack.
spoken_features: omo 使用砂拉越地方词义；其余表达采用通行马来口语。
kat 对应 di；dah 对应 sudah。
ya 用于缓和请求。
标准语译句以 serbuk pencuci pakaian 替换地方词 omo。

messages.speaker: Lina (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Omo kat rumah dah habis, tolong beli satu pek ya.
messages.ms_standard: Serbuk pencuci pakaian di rumah sudah habis. Tolong beli satu pek.
messages.zh: 家里的洗衣粉用完了，帮忙买一包哦。
messages.en: We’re out of washing powder. Please pick up a pack.

messages.speaker: Aina (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Boleh, aku nak pergi kedai kejap lagi. Pek kecil je kan?
messages.ms_standard: Boleh, saya hendak pergi ke kedai sebentar lagi. Pek kecil sahaja, bukan?
messages.zh: 可以，我等下就去商店。买小包的就行，对吧？
messages.en: Sure, I’m heading to the shop in a bit. Just a small pack, right?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 该词本身没有明显不敬含义，但属于地方用语。与不熟悉砂拉越表达的人交谈时，说 serbuk pencuci pakaian 更容易理解。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 当地家庭聊天可采用泛指用法；采购单、产品说明和跨地区沟通宜使用标准名称。若特指商业品牌，应写作 OMO，并明确品牌要求。

etymology.historical_story: Sarawak community word lists record omo for washing powder. OMO is also an established laundry detergent brand, making a brand-to-product shift a plausible explanation for the regional expression. That connection remains an inference here: the available sources do not establish when local speakers adopted the term or document its precise route into everyday speech. [OMO brand](https://www.unilever.com/brands/home-care/omo/)
